Kerry.name: Kerry
Kerry.description: A doctor. Do they always treat you? Or did you break their heart?

Ada Black.name: Ada Black
Ada Black.description: A famous performer. Darling of the sector. Perhaps her tours can be good covers to sneak into blockaded areas?

Kenn.name: Kenn
Kenn.description: A family member. Are they also a mechanic? Were you both vying for a parent's attentions?

Battro.name: Battro
Battro.description: A bounty hunter. Have they let you go before? Are they looking for you now?

Je-zee.name: Je-zee
Je-zee.description: A diplomat. Were you from allied factions or of opposing goals?

Alben.name: Alben
Alben.description: A former patient. What did you treat them for? How can they help you now?

Len.name: Len
Len.description: A black market dealer. Do they get you the parts no one else can? Did you fail to deliver something you promised?

Lynie.name: Lynie
Lynie.description: A hospital admin. An old boss? Did they get in trouble for something you did?

Rakka.name: Rakka
Rakka.description: A diplomat. Which faction do they represent? How did you befriend someone so influential?

Ibo-one.name: Ibo-one
Ibo-one.description: An ancient Cult mystic. Perhaps a guide into dangerous Ur ruins where you could hide?

Rhin.name: Rhin
Rhin.description: A smuggler. A trustworthy source that passes on tips? A rogue that came up in the ranks with you? Or a rival in your line of work?

Slice.name: Slice
Slice.description: A junkyard owner. What parts do they save for you? Or did you boost something of theirs?

Ditha.name: Ditha
Ditha.description: A family member. Are they supportive of your work? Or are they trying to get you to come home?

Juda.name: Juda
Juda.description: A doctor. Do they still help you? Or was this an old rival who wants you punished for unlawful practice of medicine?

Choss.name: Choss
Choss.description: A professional racer. Do you have hot tips for each other? Or are you always striving to outdo each other?

Citani.name: Citani
Citani.description: A reclusive info broker. Who's their boss when they're not with the crew? What type of info do they commonly broker?

T'kala.name: T'kala
T'kala.description: A dockmaster. Did he help you get your ship?

Laxx.name: Laxx
Laxx.description: A xeno. Unusual friend or a dangerous foe? Way sensitive or your "normal" friend?

Alor.name: Alor
Alor.description: A keen-eared barkeep. A good source of jobs, and a good source of drinks. What do you bring him from your travels?

Tiko Lux.name: Tiko Lux
Tiko Lux.description: A hotshot pilot. The best, but kicked out of the Legion. A getaway driver for you?

Lix.name: Lix
Lix.description: A xeno tracker. Is he a xeno with a trait for tracking people or someone that hunts xenos?

Nyx.name: Nyx
Nyx.description: A moneylender. Are you a favorite client? Or a deadbeat with a debt?

Jackev.name: Jackev
Jackev.description: A drug dealer. Legitimate hookup or feeding a vice? Or did you cut into their profits?

Horux.name: Horux
Horux.description: A former teacher. Do you go to them for advice even now? Or do they feel you've misused their teachings?

Stev.name: Stev
Stev.description: A gambler of ill repute. Are you long-standing friends? Did you cheat at their table?

Arlox.name: Arlox
Arlox.description: An Ashen Knives Pasha. Once an assassin, now Syndicate leader. Do you also hunt illegal bounties for them?

Tyura.name: Tyura
Tyura.description: A legendary assassin. How did you earn her loyalty? What is her beef with the Hegemony?

Ishi.name: Ishi
Ishi.description: A weapons dealer. Bounties come armed, and Ishi evens the field. Do they tune your ship?

Chon-zek.name: Chon-zek
Chon-zek.description: A bounty hunter. Former partner? Or a competitor from the same background?

Yazu.name: Yazu
Yazu.description: A crooked cop. Family to cover up your tracks or someone who still hunts you for getting them in trouble?

Arryn.name: Arryn
Arryn.description: A Noble. An old friend or relative? Or someone you overstepped your bounds with?

Rye.name: Rye
Rye.description: An unrequited love. Was it your training and customs that got between you?

Manda.name: Manda
Manda.description: A Guild member. Do you get the inside scoop? Or did you steal Guild secrets?

Jezri.name: Jezri
Jezri.description: A fixer. Whatever you need, Jezri has. Info, gear, jobs, friends, and enemies. Did Jezri help you get your ship or license?

Blish.name: Blish
Blish.description: A fellow mystic. Walking the same path or with wildly different beliefs about the Way?

Stacey Weathers.name: Stacey Weathers
Stacey Weathers.description: Ace reporter. Has all sorts of hot leads, but what does she ask for in return?

Meris.name: Meris
Meris.description: A scoundrel. Have you been on jobs together? Have they double-crossed you before?

Ora.name: Ora
Ora.description: An info broker. Always coming to you with juicy tip?

Krieger.name: Krieger
Krieger.description: A blaster pistol. Is this your favorite sidearm? Or is a rival carrying it to use on you?

Mav.name: Mav
Mav.description: A former mentor. What tricks did they teach you? Are they now jealous of your skill?

Nisa.name: Nisa
Nisa.description: A previous employer. A captain or a business owner? Did it end well?

Triv.name: Triv
Triv.description: A ship mechanic. Have they always helped you with your ship? Did you "forget" to pay them for a big upgrade?

Jal.name: Jal
Jal.description: A ship mechanic. Have they always helped you with your ship? Or is the ship theirs and they want their due?

?.description: Write in someone from your past when so inspired. If you gain the ability Old Friends, extend this list whenever you land in a new place.

Garin.name: Garin
Garin.description: A Guild weapons engineer. Does his conscience not let him do all the Guild demands? Did he help you acquire your ship?

Yattu.name: Yattu
Yattu.description: A gang boss. Did you use to fly for them? Did you leave them in the lurch on a job?

Heani.name: Heani
Heani.description: A tugboat captain. How often do you pass each other in the black? When did they bring you back to safety?

Hicks.name: Hicks
Hicks.description: A mystic goods supplier. A reliable supplier of Vosian crystals, or a callous opportunist preying on your faith?

Aya.name: Aya
Aya.description: An assassin. An old lover still fond of you? A heart spurned? Or are you the target that got away?

Shod.name: Shod
Shod.description: A weapons dealer. A mentor or former partner who cashed out? Someone you owe?
